top_signals.title: Stocks and Bonds Drift as Brent Ends Run of Losses: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks struggled for direction as Brent crude rebounded from its longest losing streak this year, with traders waiting for further progress in efforts to end the US-Iran war. The dollar hit the highest level since July.
